subject: Venue advance shipment: reconsignment request and ETA reconciliation
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Advance shipment: need reconsignment + updated ETA

Hi team,

Quick one — our crate for the Horizon booth (PO #HZN-4432) landed on the manifest bound for the vendor's consolidation yard, but the consignee on the proforma BOL is currently the forwarding house, not Horizon Event Services or the venue. The venue requires the crate be consigned to Horizon (their in-house drayage) for express unload on arrival to avoid storage fees. Can LogiCo reconsign the shipment to: 

Horizon Event Services
Attn: Sarah Martinez
Account #: 8432
Moscone Center - Advance Receiving

Attached: proforma_bill_of_lading.pdf (current BOL). Please confirm whether you can reconsign in-transit, what additional paperwork you need, and provide an updated ETA to the advance warehouse. Also let us know if there are any surcharge implications for reconsignment or rail reroute.

We have an on-site install window starting 05/23 and cannot absorb more than 48 hours of detention without ramping to an air diversion. Appreciate a quick confirmation.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Field Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: proforma_bill_of_lading.pdf
From: LogiCo Logistics <ops@logico-corp.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Horizon Event Services <sarah@horizonevents.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Advance shipment: need reconsignment + updated ETA

Hi Irene,

Thanks for flagging. We received the proforma BOL. We can request an in-transit reconsignment to Horizon Event Services, but to proceed we'll need:

- Signed authorization from the shipper or consignee (PDF reply is fine)
- Any venue-specific broker authorization form (if Horizon has one)
- Confirmation of who will pay for any reconsignment/rail-to-truck surcharge (we estimate $320–$520 depending on routing)

We also need clear photos of the crate labels (to match POD on arrival) — if you can attach those it speeds the gate release. I can provisionally update the manifest and submit the request to the port desk, but final acceptance requires the signed authorization.

Heads-up: current vessel ETA to Oakland is 05/21 with a tentative berth on 05/22; once the vessel berths it typically takes 24–36 hours to clear and interline. If the berth shifts we may see a 1–2 day slip. I will update you as soon as the port confirms the berth.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Ops Lead, LogiCo Logistics
ops@logico-corp.com
Phone: +1 (510) 555-9988

Attachments: none

Rafael — please proceed with the in-transit reconsignment. Horizon is approved as the consignee and will be responsible for final drayage. Use account #8432 for billing.

I've attached updated routing instructions (routing_instructions_v2.docx) outlining the pallet order and preferred offload sequence — Horizon needs the booth crate first. Marissa, can you send the crate photos Irene mentioned and confirm the signed authorization (we can use a short email approval) so LogiCo has everything to move?
